task_objective: Implement the update-check-suppression plan: make the pending-install automatic-check no-op debug-only and prevent install state transitions from re-running the hydration and automatic-check effects.

T1: logs a suppressed automatic check at debug after an install
T2: does not re-run hydration or automatic update-check effects after an install

design_decisions: Added the shared ../utils/logging mock required by the plan and verified every pre-existing case in pluginUpdateController.test.tsx still passed.
Kept logUpdate defaulting to info and passed debug only for automatic_check_suppressed_pending_install; check_reuse remains info.
Kept checkForUpdates and its dependency array unchanged. The hydration and automatic-check effects now invoke checkForUpdatesRef.current and omit only checkForUpdates from their dependency arrays.
Preserved all five useEffect calls and their order. The test documents that hydration is index 2 and automatic checks is index 4.

The T2 test conditionally executes an effect when its dependency comparison changes, so the absent suppression log is load-bearing in the hand-rolled React mock rather than a consequence of the mock not scheduling effects.

tdd_and_mutation_evidence.T1_red: The new logging test failed with info received where debug was expected for automatic_check_suppressed_pending_install; the completed-install fixture also produced check_start at info.
tdd_and_mutation_evidence.T1_mutation_gate: Reverting only pluginUpdateController.tsx made the T1 logging test fail with info received where debug was expected; mutation_exit=1.
tdd_and_mutation_evidence.T2_red: The new install-transition test failed its hydration dependency identity comparison after INSTALL_SUCCESS; 1 failed and 380 passed.
tdd_and_mutation_evidence.T2_mutation_gate: Reverting only pluginUpdateController.tsx made the T2 hydration dependency identity comparison fail; mutation_exit=1.

V1.result: exit 0; Vitest 34 files/381 tests passed, TypeScript typecheck and Rollup build passed, Ruff check/format and ty passed, Pytest 1059 passed, and review-note deletion protection passed.
V1.baseline_comparison: Vitest increased by exactly two tests; Pytest count remained 1059. The worktree was clean afterward.

V2.result: exit 0; 1 file and 11 tests passed. Verbose evidence named both 'dependency arrays for re-check effects do not change on check result' and 'does not re-run hydration or automatic update-check effects after an install'.

V3.result: Passed: the reverted frontend suite exited 1 and named both T1 and T2 tests as failures. The controller was restored with a clean worktree.

source_disagreements: None. Before edits, the controller declared exactly five useEffect calls, with hydration at index 2 and automatic checks at index 4, and checkForUpdatesRef already existed and was refreshed during render as described by the plan.
deferred_verification: No on-device verification was performed. After a dev release, install the build, enable debug logging, install a further QAM update, and inspect the newest /home/deck/homebrew/logs/SDH-Ludusavi/ log: it should have zero INFO automatic_check_suppressed_pending_install lines and at most one DEBUG line for the install.
The reduction in get_update_check_context backend RPCs is inferred from preventing the two effect re-runs; it was not measured across a real Deck install.
The assertions run against the hand-rolled React hook mock. It models dependency identity but not batching, StrictMode double invocation, or effect cleanup ordering.
The pending-install automatic-check guard decision is unchanged and was assumed correct by this plan.
results: All planned implementation commits, required mutation gates, and V1-V3 verification completed successfully. Ready for orchestrated review.
